title: A Minimalist Approach to Offline Reinforcement Learning

methods.one_paragraph_description: TD3 with two changes: (1) a behavior-cloning MSE term added to the deterministic policy update, weighted against Q by lambda = alpha / mean|Q(s,a)| (estimated over the mini-batch); (2) state features normalized by per-feature dataset mean and std. Everything else is unmodified TD3.
methods.conventional_lineage_hint: offline RL ('present an offline RL algorithm which requires minimal modifications to a pre-existing deep RL algorithm'; TD3 + behavior cloning regularizer)

alpha.location: Table 4 / Section 5 ('We use α = 2.5 in our experiments.')

alpha_tuning.value: tuned over (1, 2, 2.5, 3, 4) on Hopper-medium-v0 and Hopper-expert-v0, single held-out seed
alpha_tuning.quote: For TD3+BC, only α was tuned in the range (1, 2, 2.5, 3, 4) on Hopper-medium-v0 and Hopper-expert-v0 on a single seed which was unused in final reported results.

state_normalization.quote: Secondly, we normalize the features of every state in the provided dataset.

training_steps.quote: We train each algorithm for 1 million time steps and evaluate every 5000 time steps.

eval_frequency.quote: We train each algorithm for 1 million time steps and evaluate every 5000 time steps. Each evaluation consists of 10 episodes.

evaluation_protocol.episodes_per_seed: 10 per evaluation, averaged over final 10 evaluations (100 episodes)
evaluation_protocol.quote: Table 2: Average normalized score over the final 10 evaluations and 5 seeds.

dataset_version.quote: All D4RL datasets [Fu et al., 2020] use the v0 version.
dataset_version.location: Appendix B (Table 9 re-runs on -v2: 'we re-run TD3+BC on the -v2 datasets')
